snippet.title: Kamilia - Reveal Trailer | Steam | 2025
snippet.description:
#trailer #comingsoon #Kamilia #rqplay 
Kamilia is a story-driven, choice-matter detective mystery. Follow a talented painter who finds himself wrapped up in an unsolved case, as he tries to unveil a hidden truth that has been buried for years.

WISHLIST ON STEAM: 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2654030/Kamilia/

*The footage in the trailer was taken during early development stage.
Graphical improvements and changes may be added to the final version.
